sections.title: Active Recall
sections.text: RecallWeave should use local-only writes, hosted read-through as read-only context, and visible hybrid retrieval traces. Dense, sparse, graph, and temporal channels should stay inspectable so a production miss can be diagnosed.

sections.title: Lifecycle Note
sections.text: Hermes and OpenClaw lifecycle hooks should recall before prompt build and preserve compact checkpoints before compression when enabled by policy.

sections.title: Guardrails
sections.text: Public UI evidence must use sanitized fixture data. Private spans, key-shaped text, raw agent logs, and real memories must not appear in screenshots, traces, or compiled prompt previews.
